Ant Laudes.ant: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

Ant Laudes.ant: Majórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

Ant Laudes.ant: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

Ant Laudes.ant: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In omnem terram * exívit sonus eórum, et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Their sound * hath gone forth into all the earth: and their words unto the ends of the world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Clamavérunt justi, * et Dóminus exaudívit eos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The just cried * and the Lord heard them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Constítues eos * príncipes super omnem terram: mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Príncipes populórum * congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The princes of the people * are gathered together, with the God of Abraham.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dedísti hereditátem * timéntibus nomen tuum, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou hast given an inheritance * to them that fear thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Annuntiavérunt * ópera Dei, et facta ejus intellexérunt.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They declared * the works of God, and understood his doings.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exaltabúntur * córnua justi, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The horns of the just * shall be exalted. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lux orta est * justo, allelúja, rectis corde lætítia, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Light is risen * to the just, alleluia, and joy to the right of heart. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Custodiébant * testimónia ejus, et præcépta ejus, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
Ant Vespera.antEng: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Jurávit Dóminus, * et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Lord hath sworn * and will not repent: thou art a Priest for ever.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Cóllocet eum * Dóminus cum princípibus pópuli sui.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: That the Lord may set him * with the princes of his people.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dirupísti, Dómine, * víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O Lord, thou hast loosed my bonds; * I will offer thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Eúntes ibant * et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: They went forth weeping * sowing their seed.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Confortátus est * principátus eórum, et honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O God, thy friends are honourable; * their power is waxen right strong.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof

Ant Laudes.ant: Læva ejus * sub cápite meo, et déxtera illíus amplexábitur me.
Ant Laudes.antEng: His left hand is under my head, * and his right hand doth embrace me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Nigra sum, * sed formósa, fíliæ Jerúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I am black but comely, * O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber.

Ant Laudes.ant: Jam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away.

Ant Laudes.ant: Speciósa * facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful * and gentle in thy gladness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedícta tu * in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut myrrha * elécta, odórem dedísti suavitátis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * thou hast yielded a pleasant odor like the best myrrh.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ante torum * hujus Vírginis frequentáte nobis dúlcia cántica drámatis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing for us again and again before this maiden's bed * the tender idylls of the play.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Spécie tua * et pulchritúdine tua inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In thy comeliness and thy beauty, * go forward, fare prosperously, and reign.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adjuvábit eam * Deus vultu suo: Deus in médio ejus, non commovébitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: God shall help * her with His countenance: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut lætántium * ómnium nostrum habitátio est in te, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * all we who dwell in thee are in gladness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gaude, María Virgo: * cunctas hǽreses sola interemísti in univérso mundo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joy to thee, * O Virgin Mary, thou hast trampled down all the heresies in the whole world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dignáre me * laudáre te, Virgo sacráta: da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be; * give me strength against thine enemies.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Post partum, * Virgo, invioláta permansísti: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: After thy delivery thou still remainest a virgin; * undefiled Mother of God, pray for us.

Ant Completorium.antEng: Ant. We take refuge * under thy protection, O holy Mother of God! Despise not our supplications in our need, but deliver us always from all dangers, O Virgin, glorious and blessed!

Ant Laudes.ant: Assúmpta est María in cælum: * gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mary hath been taken to heaven; * the Angels rejoice; they praise and bless the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: María Virgo assúmpta est * ad æthéreum thálamum, in quo Rex regum stelláto sedet sólio.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Virgin Mary hath been taken into the chamber on high, * where the King of kings sitteth on a throne amid the stars.

Ant Laudes.ant: In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: We run after thee, on the scent of thy perfumes * the virgins love thee heartily.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícta * fília tu a Dómino: quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed of the Lord art thou, O daughter, * for by thee we have been given to eat of the fruit of the tree of Life.

Ant Laudes.ant: Pulchra es, * et decóra, fília Jerúsalem: terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Fair and comely art thou, O daughter of Jerusalem, * terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array.

Ant Laudes.ant: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Joseph. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel Gabriel was sent * to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph; and the virgin's name was Mary. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Hail, Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ne tímeas, María, * invenísti grátiam apud Dóminum: ecce concípies et páries fílium. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord; behold, thou shalt conceive, and bring forth a Son. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Dabit ei Dóminus * sedem David, patris ejus, et regnábit in ætérnum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord shall give unto Him * the throne of His father David, and of His kingdom there shall be no end. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, * be it unto me according to thy word. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.antEng: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be; * give me strength against thine enemies.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ángelus Dómini * nuntiávit Maríæ, et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: After thy delivery thou still remainest a virgin; * undefiled Mother of God, pray for us.

Ant Completorium.antEng: Ant. We take refuge * under thy protection, O holy Mother of God! Despise not our supplications in our need, but deliver us always from all dangers, O Virgin, glorious and blessed!

Ant Laudes.ant: O admirábile commércium: * Creátor géneris humáni, animátum corpus sumens, de Vírgine nasci dignátus est; et procédens homo sine sémine, largítus est nobis suam Deitátem.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O wondrous interchange! * the Creator of mankind, taking upon him a living body, vouchsafed to be born of a pure Virgin: and by his Humanity, which was begotten in no earthly wise, hath made us partakers of his Divinity.

Ant Laudes.ant: Quando natus es * ineffabíliter ex Vírgine, tunc implétæ sunt Scriptúræ: sicut plúvia in vellus descendísti, ut salvum fáceres genus humánum: te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When thou wast born * all ineffably of a Virgin, then were the Scriptures fulfilled; thou camest down like the dew upon the fleece of wool, to bring salvation unto all mankind; we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Rubum, quem víderat Móyses * incombústum, conservátam agnóvimus tuam laudábilem virginitátem: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In the bush which Moses saw * unconsumed, we recognize the preservation of thy glorious virginity: holy Mother of God, intercede for us.

Ant Laudes.ant: Germinávit radix Jesse, * orta est stella ex Jacob: Virgo péperit Salvatórem; te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Root of Jesse hath budded, * the Star hath come out of Jacob, the Virgin hath borne the Saviour: we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce María génuit * nobis Salvatórem, quem Joánnes videns, exclamávit, dicens: Ecce Agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccáta mundi, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lo, Mary hath brought forth * the Saviour of whom when John saw him, he did proclaim: Behold the Lamb of God that taketh away the sins of the world, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Omnes Sancti, * quanta passi sunt torménta, ut secúri pervenírent ad palmam martýrii.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O how many torments have all the Saints suffered, * that they might attain safely unto the palm of martyrdom.

Ant Laudes.ant: Cum palma * ad regna pervenérunt Sancti, corónas decóris meruérunt de manu Dei.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Saints have attained unto the kingdom, * with palms in their hands; they have earned crowns of Majesty from the Lord's hand.

Ant Laudes.ant: Córpora Sanctórum * in pace sepúlta sunt: et vivent nómina eórum in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The bodies of the Saints are buried in peace, * and their name liveth for evermore.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mártyres Dómini * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Martyrs of the Lord, bless ye the Lord * for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mártyrum chorus * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye Martyrs, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, praise Him with the dance, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Secus decúrsus aquárum * plantávit víneam justórum, et in lege Dómini fuit volúntas eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: By the rivers of water * hath the Lord planted the vineyard of the righteous, and in His Law do they meditate day and night.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tamquam aurum * in fornáce probávit eléctos Dóminus: et quasi holocáusta accépit eos in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: As gold in the furnace * hath the Lord tried His chosen ones, and received them for ever as a burnt-offering.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Si coram homínibus * torménta passi sunt, spes electórum est immortális in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Though the elect be punished * in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dabo Sanctis meis * locum nominátum in regno Patris mei, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I will give unto My Saints a place * in the kingdom of My Father, every one by his own name, saith the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sanctis, qui in terra sunt ejus, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas inter illos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: To the Saints that are in the earth * Thou hast made all my counsels admirable.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sancti qui sperant in Dómino, * habébunt fortitúdinem, assúment pennas ut áquilæ, volábunt, et non defícient.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Saints that wait upon the Lord * shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles, they shall fly and not faint.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Justi autem * in perpétuum vivent, et apud Dóminum est merces eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The righteous live * for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tradidérunt * córpora sua in mortem, ne servírent idólis: ídeo coronáti póssident palmam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They gave up their bodies unto death * rather than serve idols and therefore have they crowns on their heads and palms in their hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce merces * Sanctórum copiósa est apud Deum: ipsi vero mórtui sunt pro Christo, et vivent in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, how great with God is the reward * of His Saints; yea, they who died for Christ's sake shall live for ever and ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mártyrum chorus * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O ye Martyrs, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, praise Him with the dance, alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Isti sunt Sancti, * qui pro testaménto Dei sua córpora tradidérunt, et in sánguine Agni lavérunt stolas suas.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: These men are holy, * for they have given up their bodies unto death for the sake of the covenant of their God, and have washed their robes in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sancti per fidem * vicérunt regna, operáti sunt justítiam, adépti sunt repromissiónes.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Saints through faith subdued kingdoms, * wrought righteousness, obtained promises.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sanctórum velut áquilæ * juvéntus renovábitur: florébunt sicut lílium in civitáte Dómini.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The youth of the Saints shall be renewed * like the eagle's they shall grow as the lily in the city of the Lord.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Abstérget Deus * omnem lácrimam ab óculis Sanctórum: et jam non erit ámplius neque luctus, neque clamor, sed nec ullus dolor: quóniam prióra transiérunt.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: God shall wipe away all tears from the eyes of His Saints * and there shall be no more sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain; for the former things are passed away.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: In cæléstibus regnis * Sanctórum habitátio est, et in ætérnum réquies eórum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: In the heavenly kingdoms, * there is the dwelling of the Saints there shall be their rest for ever and ever.

Ant Matutinum.antEng: I will give unto My Saints a place * in the kingdom of My Father, every one by his own name, saith the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sanctis, qui in terra sunt ejus, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas inter illos.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sancti qui sperant in Dómino, * habébunt fortitúdinem, assúment pennas ut áquilæ, volábunt, et non defícient.

Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Saints through faith subdued kingdoms, * wrought righteousness, obtained promises.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sanctórum velut áquilæ * juvéntus renovábitur: florébunt sicut lílium in civitáte Dómini.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The youth of the Saints shall be renewed * like the eagle's they shall grow as the lily in the city of the Lord.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Abstérget Deus * omnem lácrimam ab óculis Sanctórum: et jam non erit ámplius neque luctus, neque clamor, sed nec ullus dolor: quóniam prióra transiérunt.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: In cæléstibus regnis * Sanctórum habitátio est, et in ætérnum réquies eórum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: In the heavenly kingdoms, * there is the dwelling of the Saints there shall be their rest for ever and ever.

Ant Laudes.antEng: Your saints, O Lord, * flourish like lilies, alleluia: and like the smell of balsam are before you, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: In cæléstibus regnis * Sanctórum habitátio est, allelúja: et in ætérnum réquies eórum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In the heavenly kingdom is the habitation of the saints, alleluia: and they rest in the eternity, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: In velaménto * clamábant Sancti tui, Dómine, allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.

Ant Laudes.antEng: Spirits and souls * of the just, sing hymns to our Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Fulgébunt justi * sicut sol in conspéctu Dei, allelúja.

Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Læténtur omnes * qui sperant in te, Dómine; quóniam tu benedixísti justo, scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice, O Lord, for Thou hast blessed the righteous; * Thou hast compassed him with thy favour as with a shield.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra! quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctum tuum, et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, our Ruler, * how excellent is thy Name in all the earth, Who hast crowned thine holy one with glory and honour, and made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * iste Sanctus habitábit in tabernáculo tuo, operátus est justítiam, requiéscet in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, this thy Saint * shall dwell in thy tabernacle, and this that hath worked righteousness shall abide upon thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vitam pétiit * a te, et tribuísti ei, Dómine: glóriam et magnum decórem imposuísti super eum; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He asked life of thee, * and Thou, O Lord, gavest it; honour and great majesty hast Thou laid upon him; Thou hast set a crown of precious stones upon his head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hic accípiet * benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo: quia hæc est generátio quæréntium Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He shall receive * a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from the God of his salvation, for this is the generation of them that seek the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Vespera.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Vespera.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.

Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hæc est Virgo sápiens, * et una de número prudéntum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This is one of the wise virgins, * one chosen out of the number of the careful.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hæc est Virgo sápiens, * quam Dóminus vigilántem invénit.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This is one of the wise virgins, * whom the Lord found watching.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hæc est quæ nescívit * torum in delícto: habébit fructum in respectióne animárum sanctárum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This, is one which hath not known the sinful bed, * she shall have fruit in the visitation of holy souls.

Ant Laudes.ant: Veni, elécta mea, * et ponam in te thronum meum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Come, O my chosen one, * and I will establish My throne in thee.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ista est speciósa * inter fílias Jerúsalem.
Ant Laudes.antEng: She is beautiful * among the daughters of Jerusalem.

Ant Matutinum.ant: O quam pulchra * est casta generátio cum claritáte!
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O how lovely and glorious * is the generation of the chaste.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ante torum * hujus Vírginis frequentáte nobis dúlcia cántica drámatis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing for us again and again before this maiden's bed * the tender idylls of the play.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Revértere, * revértere, Sunamítis; revértere, ut intueámur te.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Return, return, O Shulammith * Return, return, that we may look upon thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Spécie tua * et pulchritúdine tua inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In thy comeliness and thy beauty, * go forward, fare prosperously, and reign.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adjuvábit eam * Deus vultu suo: Deus in médio ejus, non commovébitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: God shall help * her with His countenance: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Aquæ multæ * non potuérunt exstínguere caritátem.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Many waters cannot * quench love.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Nigra sum, * sed formósa, fíliæ Jerúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I am black but comely, * O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Trahe me post te, * in odórem currémus unguentórum tuórum: óleum effúsum nomen tuum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Draw me after thee * we will run after the savour of thy good ointments; thy name is as oil poured forth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Veni, Sponsa Christi, * áccipe corónam, quam tibi Dóminus præparávit in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Come, Bride of Christ, * and take the everlasting crown which the Lord hath prepared for thee.

Ant Vespera.ant: In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: We will run after thee, * in the savour of thy good ointments. The virgins love them exceedingly.

Ant Vespera.ant: Jam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away.

Ant Vespera.ant: Veni, elécta mea, * et ponam in te thronum meum, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Come, O My chosen one, * and I will establish My throne in thee. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ista est speciósa * inter fílias Jerúsalem.
Ant Vespera.antEng: She is beautiful * among the daughters of Jerusalem.

Ant Laudes.ant: Domum tuam, Dómine, * decet sanctitúdo in longitúdinem diérum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Holiness becometh thine house, * O Lord, for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Domus mea, * domus oratiónis vocábitur.
Ant Laudes.antEng: My house * shall be called the house of prayer.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hæc est domus Dómini * fírmiter ædificáta, bene fundáta est supra firmam petram.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This is the Lord's house * stoutly builded, well founded upon a sure rock.

Ant Laudes.ant: Bene fundáta est * domus Dómini supra firmam petram.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord's house is well founded * upon a sure rock.

Ant Laudes.ant: Lápides pretiósi * omnes muri tui, et turres Jerúsalem gemmis ædificabúntur.
Ant Laudes.antEng: All thy walls are of stones most precious, * and the towers of Jerusalem shall be built up with jewels.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tóllite portas, * príncipes vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lift up your gates, O ye princes, * and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Erit mihi Dóminus * in Deum, et lapis iste vocábitur domus Dei.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord shall be my God, * and this stone shall be called God's house.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ædificávit * Móyses altáre Dómino Deo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Moses built an altar * to the Lord God.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Non est hic áliud, * nisi domus Dei, et porta cæli.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vidit Jacob scalam, * súmmitas ejus cælos tangébat, et descendéntes Angelos, et dixit: Vere locus iste sanctus est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Jacob beheld a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and the angels of God descending on it. And he said: Surely this place is holy.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Eréxit Jacob * lápidem in títulum, fundens óleum désuper.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Jacob set up the stone for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Qui hábitat * in adjutório Altíssimi, in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He that dwelleth in the help of the Most High * shall abide under the shadow of the God of heaven.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Templum Dómini * sanctum est, Dei structúra est, Dei ædificátio est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Temple of the Lord is holy. * The same is God's workmanship and God's building.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedícta * glória Dómini, de loco sancto suo, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed be the glory of the Lord * from His holy place. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Domum tuam, Dómine, * decet sanctitúdo in longitúdinem diérum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Holiness becometh thine house, * O Lord, for ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Domus mea, * domus oratiónis vocábitur.
Ant Vespera.antEng: My house * shall be called the house of prayer.

Ant Vespera.ant: Hæc est domus Dómini * fírmiter ædificáta, bene fundáta est supra firmam petram.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This is the Lord's house * stoutly builded, well founded upon a sure rock.

Ant Vespera.ant: Bene fundáta est * domus Dómini supra firmam petram.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord's house is well founded * upon a sure rock.

Ant Vespera.ant: Lápides pretiósi * omnes muri tui, et turres Jerúsalem gemmis ædificabúntur.
Ant Vespera.antEng: All thy walls are of stones most precious, * and the towers of Jerusalem shall be built up with jewels.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exsultábunt Dómino * ossa humiliáta.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The bones which thou hast broken * may rejoice.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exáudi, Dómine, * oratiónem meam: ad te omnis caro véniet.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lord, hear * my prayer; unto thee shall all flesh come.

Ant Laudes.ant: Me suscépit * déxtera tua, Dómine.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thy right hand * upholdeth me.

Ant Laudes.ant: A porta ínferi * érue, Dómine, ánimam meam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: From the gates of hell * deliver my soul, O Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Omnis spíritus * laudet Dóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Let everything that hath breath * praise the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dírige, * Dómine, Deus meus, in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Make my way straight before thy face, * O Lord my God.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Convértere, * Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: quóniam non est in morte, qui memor sit tui.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul * O save me for thy mercy's sake.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Nequándo rápiat * ut leo ánimam meam, dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, * while there is none to deliver, or to save.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In loco páscuæ * ibi me collocávit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He maketh me to lie down * in green pastures.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Delícta * juventútis meæ, et ignorántias meas ne memíneris, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, remember not the sins of my youth, * nor my transgressions.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Credo vidére * bona Dómini in terra vivéntium.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I believe that I shall yet see the goodness of the Lord * in the land of the living.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Compláceat * tibi, Dómine, ut erípias me: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me réspice.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me * O Lord, look upon me to help me.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sana, Dómine, * ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, heal my soul; * for I have sinned against thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sitívit * ánima mea ad Deum vivum: quando véniam, et apparébo ante fáciem Dómini?
Ant Matutinum.antEng: My soul thirsteth for the living God; * when shall I come and appear before God?

Ant Vespera.ant: Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I will walk before the Lord * in the land of the living.

Ant Vespera.ant: Heu mihi Dómine, * quia incolátus meus prolongátus est.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Woe is me! O Lord, * that my sojourn is long

Ant Vespera.ant: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, * the Lord shall keep thy soul.

Ant Vespera.ant: Si iniquitátes * observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
Ant Vespera.antEng: If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, * O Lord, who shall stand.

Ant Vespera.ant: Opera * mánuum tuárum, Dómine, ne despícias.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O Lord, forsake not * the works of thine own hands.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Læténtur omnes * qui sperant in te, Dómine; quóniam tu benedixísti justo, scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice, O Lord, for Thou hast blessed the righteous; * Thou hast compassed him with thy favour as with a shield.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra! quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctum tuum, et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, our Ruler, * how excellent is thy Name in all the earth, Who hast crowned thine holy one with glory and honour, and made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * iste Sanctus habitábit in tabernáculo tuo, operátus est justítiam, requiéscet in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, this thy Saint * shall dwell in thy tabernacle, and this that hath worked righteousness shall abide upon thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vitam pétiit * a te, et tribuísti ei, Dómine: glóriam et magnum decórem imposuísti super eum; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He asked life of thee, * and Thou, O Lord, gavest it; honour and great majesty hast Thou laid upon him; Thou hast set a crown of precious stones upon his head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hic accípiet * benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo: quia hæc est generátio quæréntium Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He shall receive * a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from the God of his salvation, for this is the generation of them that seek the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Vespera.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Vespera.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Oleum effúsum * nomen tuum, ídeo adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thy Name is as oil * poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

Ant Laudes.ant: Scitóte, * quia Dóminus ipse est Deus, cujus nomen in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Know ye that the Lord He is God, * and His Name endureth for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sitívit * ánima mea ad nomen sanctum tuum, Dómine.
Ant Laudes.antEng: My soul thirsteth * for thy Holy Name, O Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedíctum * nomen glóriæ tuæ sanctum, et laudábile, et superexaltátum in sǽcula.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed * is the Holy Name of thy glory, and worthy to be praised, and exalted above all for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Júvenes et vírgines, * senes cum junióribus laudáte nomen Dómini, quia exaltátum est nomen ejus solíus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Young men and maidens, * old men and children, praise the Name of the Lord, for His Name alone is exalted.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord our Lord, * how admirable is thy name in the whole earth!

Ant Matutinum.ant: In nómine Jesu * omne genu flectátur cæléstium, terréstrium, et infernórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: At the Name of Jesus, * let every knee bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Confitémini * Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus: mementóte, quóniam excélsum est nomen ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Praise the Lord, * and call upon His Name; remember that His Name is exalted.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mémores erunt * nóminis tui, Dómine, in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They shall be mindful * of thy Name, O Lord, unto all generations.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Magnificáte * Dóminum mecum, et exaltémus nomen ejus in idípsum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O magnify * the Lord with me, and let us exalt His Name together.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Omnes gentes, * quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine, et glorificábunt nomen tuum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: All nations * whom Thou hast made, shall come and worship before thee, O Lord, and shall glorify thy Name.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Cantáte Dómino * et benedícite nómini ejus: annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing unto the Lord, * and bless His Name show forth His salvation from day to day.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Secúndum nomen tuum, * Deus, sic et laus tua in fines terræ: justítia plena est déxtera tua.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: According to thy Name, O God, * so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth; thy right hand is full of righteousness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Cantáte Deo, * psalmum dícite nómini ejus: iter fácite ei, qui ascéndit super occásum, Dóminus nomen illi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing unto God, * sing praises to His Name; spread a path before Him That rideth upon the heavens the Lord is His Name.

Ant Vespera.ant: Omnis * qui invocáverit nomen Dómini, salvus erit.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Whosoever shall call * on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

Ant Vespera.ant: Sanctum et terríbile * nomen ejus, inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Holy and terrible * is His Name; the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ego autem * in Dómino gaudébo, et exsultábo in Deo Jesu meo.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Yet will I rejoice * in the Lord I will joy in the God of my salvation.

Ant Vespera.ant: A solis ortu * usque ad occásum laudábile nomen Dómini.
Ant Vespera.antEng: From the rising of the sun * unto the going down of the same the Lord's Name is to be praised.

Ant Vespera.ant: Sacrificábo * hóstiam laudis, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I will offer * the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the Name of the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: O admirábile commércium: * Creátor géneris humáni, animátum corpus sumens, de Vírgine nasci dignátus est; et procédens homo sine sémine, largítus est nobis suam Deitátem.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O wondrous interchange! * the Creator of mankind, taking upon him a living body, vouchsafed to be born of a pure Virgin: and by his Humanity, which was begotten in no earthly wise, hath made us partakers of his Divinity.

Ant Laudes.ant: Quando natus es * ineffabíliter ex Vírgine, tunc implétæ sunt Scriptúræ: sicut plúvia in vellus descendísti, ut salvum fáceres genus humánum: te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When thou wast born * all ineffably of a Virgin, then were the Scriptures fulfilled; thou camest down like the dew upon the fleece of wool, to bring salvation unto all mankind; we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Rubum, quem víderat Móyses * incombústum, conservátam agnóvimus tuam laudábilem virginitátem: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In the bush which Moses saw * unconsumed, we recognize the preservation of thy glorious virginity: holy Mother of God, intercede for us.

Ant Laudes.ant: Germinávit radix Jesse, * orta est stella ex Jacob: Virgo péperit Salvatórem; te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Root of Jesse hath budded, * the Star hath come out of Jacob, the Virgin hath borne the Saviour: we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce María génuit * nobis Salvatórem, quem Joánnes videns, exclamávit, dicens: Ecce Agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccáta mundi, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lo, Mary hath brought forth * the Saviour of whom when John saw him, he did proclaim: Behold the Lamb of God that taketh away the sins of the world, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dóminus dixit * ad me: Fílius meus es tu, ego hódie génui te.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath said unto Me: Thou art My Son, * this day have I begotten thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In sole pósuit * tabernáculum suum: et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In the sun hath He set His tabernacle * and He is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Elevámini, * portæ æternáles, et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors, * and the King of glory shall come in.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Speciósus forma * præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou art fairer than the children of men, * grace is poured into thy lips.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Homo natus est * in ea, et ipse fundávit eam Altíssimus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This man was born in her, * and the Highest Himself hath established her.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exsultábunt ómnia ligna * silvárum ante fáciem Dómini, quóniam venit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: All the trees of the wood shall rejoice * before the Lord, for He cometh.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In princípio, * et ante sǽcula Deus erat Verbum, et ipse natus est hódie Salvátor mundi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In the beginning, * and before the worlds, the Word was God, and this day is He born the Saviour of the world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ante lucíferum génitus, * et ante sǽcula, Dóminus Salvátor noster hódie nasci dignátus est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord our Saviour, * begotten before the daystar, and before the worlds, hath this day vouchsafed to be born.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Nato Dómino, * Angelórum chorus canébat, dicens: Salus Deo nostro, sedénti super thronum, et Agno.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When the Lord was born the Angels sang together, * saying: Salvation to our God, Which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

Ant Vespera.ant: O admirábile commércium: * Creátor géneris humáni, animátum corpus sumens, de Vírgine nasci dignátus est; et procédens homo sine sémine, largítus est nobis suam Deitátem.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O wondrous interchange! * the Creator of mankind, taking upon him a living body, vouchsafed to be born of a pure Virgin: and by his Humanity, which was begotten in no earthly wise, hath made us partakers of his Divinity.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quando natus es * ineffabíliter ex Vírgine, tunc implétæ sunt Scriptúræ: sicut plúvia in vellus descendísti, ut salvum fáceres genus humánum: te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Vespera.antEng: When thou wast born * all ineffably of a Virgin, then were the Scriptures fulfilled; thou camest down like the dew upon the fleece of wool, to bring salvation unto all mankind; we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Rubum, quem víderat Móyses * incombústum, conservátam agnóvimus tuam laudábilem virginitátem: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: In the bush which Moses saw * unconsumed, we recognize the preservation of thy glorious virginity: holy Mother of God, intercede for us.

Ant Vespera.ant: Germinávit radix Jesse, * orta est stella ex Jacob: Virgo péperit Salvatórem; te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Root of Jesse hath budded, * the Star hath come out of Jacob, the Virgin hath borne the Saviour: we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce María génuit * nobis Salvatórem, quem Joánnes videns, exclamávit, dicens: Ecce Agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccáta mundi, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Lo, Mary hath brought forth * the Saviour of whom when John saw him, he did proclaim: Behold the Lamb of God that taketh away the sins of the world, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ante lucíferum génitus, * et ante sǽcula, Dóminus Salvátor noster hódie mundo appáruit.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord our Saviour, * begotten before the day-star, and before the ages, is this day made manifest in the world.

Ant Laudes.ant: Venit lumen tuum * Jerúsalem, et glória Dómini super te orta est, et ambulábunt gentes in lúmine tuo, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O Jerusalem, * thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee, and the Gentiles shall walk in thy light. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Apértis thesáuris suis * obtulérunt Magi Dómino aurum, thus, et myrrham, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When the wise men * had opened their treasures, they presented unto the Lord gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mária et flúmina * benedícite Dómino: hymnum dícite fontes Dómino, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye seas and floods, * bless ye the Lord. O ye wells, bless ye the Lord. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Stella ista * sicut flamma corúscat, et Regem regum Deum demónstrat: Magi eam vidérunt, et magno Regi múnera obtulérunt.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This star shineth * as a flame of fire, and pointeth out God, the King of kings: the Wise Men beheld it, and offered gifts unto the great King.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Afférte Dómino * fílii Dei, adoráte Dóminum in aula sancta ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Give unto the Lord, O ye sons of God, * worship the Lord in His holy courts.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Flúminis ímpetus * lætíficat, allelúja, civitátem Dei, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: It is a river, the streams whereof make glad, * alleluia, the city of God, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Psállite Deo nostro, * psállite: psállite Regi nostro, psállite sapiénter.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing praises to our God, sing praises * sing praises unto our King, sing ye praises with understanding.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Omnis terra adóret te, * et psallat tibi: psalmum dicat nómini tuo, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all the earth worship thee, and sing unto thee * let them sing praises to thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Reges Tharsis * et ínsulæ múnera ófferent Regi Dómino.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The kings of Tarshish and the isles shall bring presents * unto the Lord the King.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Omnes gentes * quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come * and worship before thee, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Homo natus est * in ea, et ipse fundávit eam Altíssimus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This man was born in her, * and the Highest Himself hath established her.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adoráte Dóminum, * allelúja: in aula sancta ejus, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O worship the Lord, * alleluia, in His holy temple, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adoráte Deum, * allelúja: omnes Angeli ejus, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Worship God, * alleluia, all ye His Angels, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ante lucíferum génitus, * et ante sǽcula, Dóminus Salvátor noster hódie mundo appáruit.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord our Saviour, * begotten before the day-star, and before the ages, is this day made manifest in the world.

Ant Vespera.ant: Venit lumen tuum * Jerúsalem, et glória Dómini super te orta est, et ambulábunt gentes in lúmine tuo, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O Jerusalem, * thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee, and the Gentiles shall walk in thy light. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Apértis thesáuris suis * obtulérunt Magi Dómino aurum, thus, et myrrham, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: When the wise men * had opened their treasures, they presented unto the Lord gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mária et flúmina * benedícite Dómino: hymnum dícite fontes Dómino, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O ye seas and floods, * bless ye the Lord. O ye wells, bless ye the Lord. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Stella ista * sicut flamma corúscat, et Regem regum Deum demónstrat: Magi eam vidérunt, et magno Regi múnera obtulérunt.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This star shineth * as a flame of fire, and pointeth out God, the King of kings: the Wise Men beheld it, and offered gifts unto the great King.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ingréssa Agnes * turpitúdinis locum, Angelum Dómini præparátum invénit.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Agnes entered * the place of shame, and found the Angel of the Lord ready.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mecum enim hábeo * custódem córporis mei, Angelum Dómini.
Ant Laudes.antEng: For I have with me * an Angel of the Lord to keep my body.

Ant Laudes.ant: Anulo suo * subarrhávit me Dóminus meus Jesus Christus, et tamquam sponsam decorávit me coróna.
Ant Laudes.antEng: My Lord Jesus Christ hath espoused me with His ring, * and hath set on my head a crown as the crown of a bride.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Jesu Christi, quia per Fílium tuum ignis exstínctus est a látere meo.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I bless thee, O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, because through thy Son the fire is quenched around me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Congaudéte mecum * et congratulámini, quia cum his ómnibus lúcidas sedes accépi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Rejoice with me * and make merry, because I also have received a throne in light among all these.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Discéde a me, * pábulum mortis, quia jam ab álio amatóre prævénta sum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Depart from me, prey of death, for I am prevented by another Lover.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Déxteram meam * et collum meum cinxit lapídibus pretiósis, trádidit áuribus meis inæstimábiles margarítas.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: My right hand and my neck hath He clasped with precious stones, and put pearls beyond price in mine ears.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Pósuit signum * in fáciem meam, ut nullum præter eum amatórem admíttam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He hath sealed me in my forehead that I may let in no other lover but Him.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Induit me Dóminus * cýclade auro texta, et imménsis monílibus ornávit me.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath clothed me with a vesture of wrought gold, and adorned me with a necklace of great price.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mel et lac * ex ejus ore suscépi, et sanguis ejus ornávit genas meas.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I have sucked honey and milk out of His Mouth, and His Blood is red on my cheeks.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ipsi soli servo fidem, * ipsi me tota devotióne commítto.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I keep my troth to Him alone, and commit me altogether to Him.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Cujus pulchritúdinem * sol et luna mirántur, ipsi soli servo fidem.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I keep my troth to Him Alone, at Whose beauty the sun and the moon do wonder.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Christus circúmdedit me * vernántibus atque coruscántibus gemmis pretiósis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Christ hath crowned me with the bright and priceless blossoms of the eternal spring-time.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ipsi sum desponsáta, * cui Angeli sérviunt, cujus pulchritúdinem sol et luna mirántur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I am wedded to the Lord of Angels, at Whose beauty the sun and the moon do wonder.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ingréssa Agnes * turpitúdinis locum, Angelum Dómini præparátum invénit.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Agnes entered * the place of shame, and found the Angel of the Lord ready.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mecum enim hábeo * custódem córporis mei, Angelum Dómini.
Ant Vespera.antEng: For I have with me * an Angel of the Lord to keep my body.

Ant Vespera.ant: Anulo suo * subarrhávit me Dóminus meus Jesus Christus, et tamquam sponsam decorávit me coróna.
Ant Vespera.antEng: My Lord Jesus Christ hath espoused me with His ring, * and hath set on my head a crown as the crown of a bride.

Ant Vespera.ant: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Jesu Christi, quia per Fílium tuum ignis exstínctus est a látere meo.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I bless thee, O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, because through thy Son the fire is quenched around me.

Ant Vespera.ant: Congaudéte mecum * et congratulámini, quia cum his ómnibus lúcidas sedes accépi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Rejoice with me * and make merry, because I also have received a throne in light among all these.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ego plantávi, * Apóllo rigávit, Deus autem increméntum dedit. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I have planted, * Apollos watered, but God gave the increase. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Libénter gloriábor * in infirmitátibus meis, ut inhábitet in me virtus Christi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory * in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Grátia Dei * in me vácua non fuit, sed grátia ejus semper in me manet.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The grace of God which was bestowed upon me was not in vain, * but His grace abideth ever in me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Damásci, præpósitus * gentis Arétæ regis vóluit me comprehéndere: a frátribus per murum demíssus sum in sporta, et sic evási manus ejus in nómine Dómini.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king was desirous to apprehend me; by the brethren in a basket was I let down by the wall, and so escaped I his hands, in the name of the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ter virgis cæsus sum, * semel lapidátus sum, ter naufrágium pértuli pro Christi nómine.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thrice was I beaten with rods, * once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, for Christ's name's sake.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Ego plantávi, * Apóllo rigávit, Deus autem increméntum dedit. Allelúja.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: I have planted, * Apollos watered, but God gave the increase. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Libénter gloriábor * in infirmitátibus meis, ut inhábitet in me virtus Christi.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory * in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Grátia Dei * in me vácua non fuit, sed grátia ejus semper in me manet.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The grace of God which was bestowed upon me was not in vain, * but His grace abideth ever in me.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Damásci, præpósitus * gentis Arétæ regis vóluit me comprehéndere: a frátribus per murum demíssus sum in sporta, et sic evási manus ejus in nómine Dómini.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king was desirous to apprehend me; by the brethren in a basket was I let down by the wall, and so escaped I his hands, in the name of the Lord.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Ter virgis cæsus sum, * semel lapidátus sum, ter naufrágium pértuli pro Christi nómine.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Thrice was I beaten with rods, * once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, for Christ's name's sake.

Ant Laudes.ant: Símeon justus * et timorátus exspectábat redemptiónem Israël, et Spíritus Sanctus erat in eo.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Simeon was just * and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Respónsum accépit Símeon * a Spíritu Sancto, non visúrum se mortem, nisi vidéret Dóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: It was revealed unto Simeon * by the Holy Ghost that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Accípiens Símeon * Púerum in mánibus, grátias agens benedíxit Dóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Simeon took * the Child up in his arms, and gave thanks, and blessed the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
Ant Laudes.antEng: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

Ant Laudes.ant: Obtulérunt * pro eo Dómino par túrturum aut duos pullos columbárum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: They offered for Him * unto the Lord, a pair of turtle doves, or two young pigeons.

Ant Nona.ant: Obtulérunt * pro eo Dómino par túrturum aut duos pullos columbárum.
Ant Nona.antEng: They offered for Him * unto the Lord, a pair of turtle doves, or two young pigeons.

Ant Prima.ant: Símeon justus * et timorátus exspectábat redemptiónem Israël, et Spíritus Sanctus erat in eo.
Ant Prima.antEng: Simeon was just * and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

Ant Sexta.ant: Accípiens Símeon * Púerum in mánibus, grátias agens benedíxit Dóminum.
Ant Sexta.antEng: Simeon took * the Child up in his arms, and gave thanks, and blessed the Lord.

Ant Tertia.ant: Respónsum accépit Símeon * a Spíritu Sancto, non visúrum se mortem, nisi vidéret Dóminum.
Ant Tertia.antEng: It was revealed unto Simeon * by the Holy Ghost that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: O admirábile commércium: * Creátor géneris humáni, animátum corpus sumens, de Vírgine nasci dignátus est; et procédens homo sine sémine, largítus est nobis suam Deitátem.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O wondrous interchange! * the Creator of mankind, taking upon him a living body, vouchsafed to be born of a pure Virgin: and by his Humanity, which was begotten in no earthly wise, hath made us partakers of his Divinity.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quando natus es * ineffabíliter ex Vírgine, tunc implétæ sunt Scriptúræ: sicut plúvia in vellus descendísti, ut salvum fáceres genus humánum: te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Vespera.antEng: When thou wast born * all ineffably of a Virgin, then were the Scriptures fulfilled; thou camest down like the dew upon the fleece of wool, to bring salvation unto all mankind; we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Rubum, quem víderat Móyses * incombústum, conservátam agnóvimus tuam laudábilem virginitátem: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: In the bush which Moses saw * unconsumed, we recognize the preservation of thy glorious virginity: holy Mother of God, intercede for us.

Ant Vespera.ant: Germinávit radix Jesse, * orta est stella ex Jacob: Virgo péperit Salvatórem; te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Root of Jesse hath budded, * the Star hath come out of Jacob, the Virgin hath borne the Saviour: we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce María génuit * nobis Salvatórem, quem Joánnes videns, exclamávit, dicens: Ecce Agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccáta mundi, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Lo, Mary hath brought forth * the Saviour of whom when John saw him, he did proclaim: Behold the Lamb of God that taketh away the sins of the world, alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Símeon justus * et timorátus exspectábat redemptiónem Israël, et Spíritus Sanctus erat in eo.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Simeon was just * and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Respónsum accépit Símeon * a Spíritu Sancto, non visúrum se mortem, nisi vidéret Dóminum.

Ant Laudes.ant: Quis es tu, * qui venísti ad me curáre vúlnera mea? Ego sum Apóstolus Christi: nihil in me dúbites, fília.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Who art thou * who comest to heal my wounds? I am an Apostle of Christ, have no fear of me, my daughter.

Ant Laudes.ant: Medicínam carnálem * córpori meo nunquam exhíbui, sed hábeo Dóminum Jesum Christum, qui solo sermóne restáurat univérsa.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I have used no earthly medicine * for my body, but I have for a Master Christ Jesus, by Whose Word alone all things were made.

Ant Laudes.ant: Grátias tibi ago, * Dómine Jesu Christe, quia memor es mei, et misísti ad me Apóstolum tuum curáre vúlnera mea.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O my Lord Jesus Christ, I thank thee, * because Thou hast been mindful of me, and hast sent unto me thine Apostle, to heal my wounds.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Jesu Christi, quia per Apóstolum tuum mamíllam meam meo péctori restituísti.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I bless thee, O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, because by thine Apostle Thou hast put new paps on my breasts.

Ant Laudes.ant: Qui me dignátus est * ab omni plaga curáre, et mamíllam meam meo péctori restitúere, ipsum ínvoco Deum vivum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Upon Him Who hath vouchsafed * to heal me of all my wounds, and to put new paps on my breasts, upon Him will I call, even upon the Living God.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ingénua sum, * et ex spectábili génere, ut omnis parentéla mea testátur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I am well born * and of a respectable family, as all my relations testify.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Summa ingenúitas * ista est, in qua sérvitus Christi comprobátur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The best of my birth is * that I was born the slave of Christ.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ancílla Christi sum, * ídeo me osténdo servílem habére persónam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I look like a slave * because I am one, the slave of Christ.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Agatha sancta * dixit: Si feras mihi promíttis, audíto Christi nómine mansuéscunt.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The holy Agatha * said: Dost thou promise me beasts? When they hear Christ's name they grow tame.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Si ignem adhíbeas, * rorem mihi salvíficum de cælo Angeli ministrábunt.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: If thou put * the fire to me, Angels will bring me a saving dew from heaven.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Agatha * lætíssime et gloriánter ibat ad cárcerem, quasi ad épulas invitáta; et agónem suum Dómino précibus commendábat.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Agatha went to prison * with great joy and exultation, like a guest to a banquet, and recommended her struggle to the Lord in prayer.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Nisi diligénter * perféceris corpus meum a carnifícibus attrectári, non potest ánima mea in paradísum Dómini cum palma intráre martýrii.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Unless thou make * the executioners to handle my body vigorously, my soul will not be able to enter into the Lord's paradise with the palm of martyrdom.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vidísti, Dómine, * agónem meum, quómodo pugnávi in stádio; sed, quia nólui obedíre mandátis príncipum, jussa sum in mamílla torquéri.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, Thou hast seen * how I have fought, and how I have run in the race; but, because I would not obey the magistrates, they ordered me to be tortured in the breasts.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Propter fidem castitátis * jussa sum suspéndi in equúleo: ádjuva me, Dómine, Deus meus, in tortúra mamillárum meárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Because of my chastity * they ordered me to be stretched upon the rack; help me, O Lord my God, for they are torturing my breasts.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quis es tu, * qui venísti ad me curáre vúlnera mea? Ego sum Apóstolus Christi: nihil in me dúbites, fília.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Who art thou * who comest to heal my wounds? I am an Apostle of Christ, have no fear of me, my daughter.

Ant Vespera.ant: Medicínam carnálem * córpori meo nunquam exhíbui, sed hábeo Dóminum Jesum Christum, qui solo sermóne restáurat univérsa.
