Ant Vespera.antEng: O my Lord Jesus Christ, I thank thee, * because Thou hast been mindful of me, and hast sent unto me thine Apostle, to heal my wounds.

Ant Vespera.ant: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Jesu Christi, quia per Apóstolum tuum mamíllam meam meo péctori restituísti.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I bless thee, O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, because by thine Apostle Thou hast put new paps on my breasts.

Ant Vespera.ant: Qui me dignátus est * ab omni plaga curáre, et mamíllam meam meo péctori restitúere, ipsum ínvoco Deum vivum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Upon Him Who hath vouchsafed * to heal me of all my wounds, and to put new paps on my breasts, upon Him will I call, even upon the Living God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Candor est * lucis ætérnæ, et spéculum sine mácula.
Ant Laudes.antEng: She is the brightness * of eternal light, and the unspotted mirror.

Ant Laudes.ant: Múlier * amícta sole, et luna sub pédibus ejus, et in cápite ejus coróna stellárum duódecim.
Ant Laudes.antEng: A woman * clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tu glória Jerúsalem, * tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou art the glory of Jerusalem, * thou art the joy of Israel, thou art the honour of our people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícta es tu, * Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed art thou, * O Virgin Mary, by the Lord, the most high God, above all women upon the earth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hódie nomen tuum * ita magnificávit Dóminus, ut non recédat laus tua de ore hóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This day the Lord * hath so magnified thy name that thy praise shall not depart out of the mouth of men.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ave, grátia plena; * Dóminus tecum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Hail, full of grace; * the Lord is with thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedícta tu inter mulíeres * et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed art thou among women * and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ne tímeas, María, * invenísti grátiam apud Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Fecit mihi magna * qui potens est, et sanctum nomen ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He that is mighty * hath done great things to me, and holy is his name.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sanctificávit * tabernáculum suum Altíssimus: Deus in médio ejus, non commovébitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The most High * hath sanctified his own tabernacle: God is in the midst thereof, she shall not be moved.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dóminus possédit te * in inítio viárum suárum, et in caritáte perpétua diléxit te.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord possessed thee * in the beginning of his ways, and he hath loved thee with everlasting love.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Manus Dómini * confortávit te, et ídeo eris benedícta in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The hand of the Lord * hath strengthened thee, and therefore thou shalt be blessed for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Noli metúere, * non enim pro te, sed pro ómnibus hæc lex constitúta est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Fear not, * for this law is not made for thee, but for all others.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedíxit te Dóminus * in virtúte sua, quia per te ad níhilum redégit inimícos nostros.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath blessed thee * by his power, because by thee he hath brought our enemies to nought.

Ant Vespera.ant: Candor est * lucis ætérnæ, et spéculum sine mácula.
Ant Vespera.antEng: She is the brightness * of eternal light, and the unspotted mirror.

Ant Vespera.ant: Múlier * amícta sole, et luna sub pédibus ejus, et in cápite ejus coróna stellárum duódecim.
Ant Vespera.antEng: A woman * clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

Ant Vespera.ant: Tu glória Jerúsalem, * tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Thou art the glory of Jerusalem, * thou art the joy of Israel, thou art the honour of our people

Ant Vespera.ant: Benedícta es tu, * Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Blessed art thou, * O Virgin Mary, by the Lord, the most high God, above all women upon the earth

Ant Vespera.ant: Hódie nomen tuum * ita magnificávit Dóminus, ut non recédat laus tua de ore hóminum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This day the Lord * hath so magnified thy name that thy praise shall not depart out of the mouth of men.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ibant paréntes Jesu * per omnes annos in Jerúsalem, in die solémni Paschæ.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The parents of Jesus * went to Jerusalem every year, at the feast of the Passover.

Ant Laudes.ant: Cum redírent, * remánsit puer Jesus in Jerúsalem, et non cognovérunt paréntes ejus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When they returned, * the Child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem, and His parents knew not of it.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non inveniéntes * Jesum, regréssi sunt in Jerúsalem requiréntes eum; et post tríduum invenérunt illum in templo sedéntem in médio doctórum, audiéntem et interrogántem eos.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When they found not Jesus, * they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking Him; and after three days they found Him in the Temple, sitting in the midst of the Doctors, both hearing them and asking them questions.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dixit Mater ejus * ad illum: Fili, quid fecísti nobis sic? Ecce pater tuus, et ego doléntes quærebámus te.
Ant Laudes.antEng: His mother said unto Him: * Son, why hast Thou thus dealt with us? Behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

Ant Laudes.ant: Descéndit Jesus * cum eis, et venit Názareth, et erat súbditus illis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Jesus went down with them, * and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ascéndit Joseph, * a Galilǽa de civitáte Názareth in Judǽam, in civitátem David, quæ vocátur Béthlehem, ut profiterétur cum María.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joseph went up * from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, to be enrolled with Mary.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Venérunt pastóres * festinántes; et invenérunt Maríam, et Joseph, et Infántem pósitum in præsépio.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The shepherds came with haste, * and found Mary and Joseph, and the Babe lying in a manger.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce Angelus Dómini * appáruit in somnis Joseph, dicens: Surge, et áccipe Púerum et Matrem ejus, et fuge in Ægýptum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, the Angel of the Lord * appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying: Arise, and take the young Child and His mother, and flee into Egypt.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Consúrgens Joseph, * accépit Púerum et Matrem ejus nocte, et secéssit in Ægýptum; et erat ibi usque ad óbitum Heródis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joseph arose, * and took the young child and His mother by night, and departed into Egypt and was there until the death of Herod.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Defúncto Heróde, * Angelus Dómini appáruit in somnis Joseph in Ægýpto, dicens: Surge, et áccipe Púerum et Matrem ejus, et vade in terram Israël; defúncti sunt enim qui quærébant ánimam Púeri.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Herod was dead, * an Angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying: Arise, and take the young Child and His mother, and go into the land of Israel; for they are dead which sought the young Child's life.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Accépit Joseph * Púerum et Matrem ejus, et venit in terram Israël.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joseph took * the young Child and His mother, and came into the land of Israel.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Audiens Joseph, * quod Archeláus regnáret in Judǽa pro Heróde patre suo, tímuit illo ire.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Joseph heard * that Archelaus did reign in Judea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Admónitus in somnis, * Joseph secéssit in partes Galilǽæ: et véniens habitávit in civitáte, quæ vocátur Názareth; ut adimplerétur quod dictum est per prophétas: Quóniam Nazarǽus vocábitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joseph, being warned of God in a dream, * turned aside into the parts of Galilee; and he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Prophets He shall be called a Nazarene.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Erat Pater Jesu * et Mater mirántes super his, quæ dicebántur de illo; et benedíxit illis Símeon.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The father and mother of Jesus * marvelled at those things which were spoken of Him; and Simeon blessed them.

Ant Vespera.ant: Jacob autem * génuit Joseph, virum Maríæ, de qua natus est Jesus, qui vocátur Christus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: And Jacob begat Joseph * the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, Who is called Christ.

Ant Vespera.ant: Missus est * Angelus Gábriel a Deo ad Vírginem desponsátam viro, cui nomen erat Joseph, de domo David, et nomen Vírginis María.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Angel Gabriel * was sent from God, unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David, and the virgin's name was Mary.

Ant Vespera.ant: Cum esset desponsáta * Mater Jesu María Joseph, ántequam convenírent, invénta est in útero habens de Spíritu Sancto.
Ant Vespera.antEng: When as Mary * the mother of Jesus, was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child, of the Holy Ghost.

Ant Vespera.ant: Joseph vir ejus, * cum esset justus, et nollet eam tradúcere, vóluit occúlte dimíttere eam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Then Joseph her husband * being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

Ant Vespera.ant: Angelus Dómini * appáruit Joseph, dicens: Joseph, fili David, noli timére accípere Maríam cónjugem tuam; quod enim in ea natum est, de Spíritu Sancto est: páriet autem fílium, et vocábis nomen ejus Jesum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord * appeared unto him in a dream, saying: Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee, Mary, thy wife; for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost: and she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call His name Jesus.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Ibant paréntes Jesu * per omnes annos in Jerúsalem, in die solémni Paschæ.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The parents of Jesus * went to Jerusalem every year, at the feast of the Passover.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Cum redírent, * remánsit puer Jesus in Jerúsalem, et non cognovérunt paréntes ejus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: When they returned, * the Child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem, and His parents knew not of it.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Non inveniéntes * Jesum, regréssi sunt in Jerúsalem requiréntes eum; et post tríduum invenérunt illum in templo sedéntem in médio doctórum, audiéntem et interrogántem eos.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: When they found not Jesus, * they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking Him; and after three days they found Him in the Temple, sitting in the midst of the Doctors, both hearing them and asking them questions.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dixit Mater ejus * ad illum: Fili, quid fecísti nobis sic? Ecce pater tuus, et ego doléntes quærebámus te.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: His mother said unto Him: * Son, why hast Thou thus dealt with us? Behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Descéndit Jesus * cum eis, et venit Názareth, et erat súbditus illis.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Jesus went down with them, * and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ingrésso Zacharía * templum Dómini, appáruit ei Gábriel Angelus, stans a dextris altáris incénsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When Zacharias went into the temple of the Lord, * there appeared unto him the Angel Gabriel, standing on the right side of the Altar of incense. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ait autem Angelus: * Ne tímeas, Zacharía, quóniam exaudíta est deprecátio tua.
Ant Laudes.antEng: But the Angel said unto him: Fear not, * Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ego sum Gábriel * Angelus, qui asto ante Dóminum, et missus sum loqui te.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I am the Angel Gabriel, * that stand in the presence of God, and am sent to speak unto thee. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Gábriel Angelus * locútus est Maríæ, dicens: Ecce concípies in útero, et páries fílium, et vocábis nomen ejus Jesum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel Gabriel spoke unto Mary * and said: Behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a Son, and shalt call His Name Jesus. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Dixit autem María * Angelum: Quómodo fiet istud, quóniam virum non cognósco? Et respóndens Gábriel Angelus, dixit ei: Spíritus Sanctus supervéniet in te et virtus altíssimi obumbrábit tibi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Then said Mary unto the Angel: How shall this be, seeing I know not a man? * And the Angel Gabriel answered and said unto her: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dixit Angelus Gábriel * ad Daniélem: Intéllige, fílii hóminis, quóniam in témpore finis implébitur vísio.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Gabriel said unto Daniel: Understand, O son of man; for at the time of the end shall the vision be fulfilled. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce vir Gábriel * quem víderam in visióne cito volans tétigit me in témpore sacrifícii vespertíni et dócuit me.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision (at the beginning,) being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation; and he informed me.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Cumque Gábriel * loquerétur ad me collápsus sum pronus in terram et tétigit me, et státuit me in gradu meo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Gabriel was about speaking unto me, I fell upon my face toward the ground; but he touched me, and set me upright

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gábriel Angelus * appáruit Zacharíæ, dicens: Uxor tua Elísabeth páriet tibi fílium, et vocábitur nomen ejus Joánnem.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Gabriel appeared unto Zacharias, and said unto him: Thy wife Elizabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et dixit Zacharías * ad Angelum: Unde hoc sciam? ego enim sum senex, et uxor mea procéssit in diébus suis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And Zacharias said unto the Angel: Whereby shall know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years

Ant Matutinum.ant: Respóndens autem Angelus * dixit ei: Ego sum Gábriel, qui asto ante Deum: et missus sum loqui ad te, et hæc tibi evangelizáre.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And the Angel, answering, said unto him: I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God, and am sent to speak unto thee, and to show thee these glad tidings

Ant Matutinum.ant: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Joseph.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Gabriel was sent to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, and the virgin's name was Mary. (Alleluia)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gábriel Angelus * Maríæ dixit: Ecce Elísabeth cognáta tua, et ipsa concépit fílium in senectúte sua.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Gabriel said unto Mary: Behold, thy cousin Elizabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age

Ant Matutinum.ant: Súscipe Verbum * Virgo María, quod tibi a Dómino per Angelum Gabriélem transmíssum est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Virgin Mary, receive the word of the Lord which is sent thee by His Angel Gabriel

Ant Vespera.ant: Ingrésso Zacharía * templum Dómini, appáruit ei Gábriel Angelus, stans a dextris altáris incénsi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: When Zacharias went into the temple of the Lord, * there appeared unto him the Angel Gabriel, standing on the right side of the Altar of incense. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Ait autem Angelus: * Ne tímeas, Zacharía, quiam exaudíta est deprecátio tua.
Ant Vespera.antEng: But the Angel said unto him: Fear not, * Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Ego sum Gábriel * Angelus, qui asto ante Deum, et missus sum loqui ad te.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I am the Angel Gabriel, * that stand in the presence of God, and am sent to speak unto thee. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Gábriel Angelus * locútus est Maríæ, dicens: Ecce concípies in útero, et páries fílium, et vocábis nomen ejus Jesum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Angel Gabriel spake unto Mary * and said: Behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a Son, and shalt call His Name Jesus. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Dixit autem María * Angelum: Quómodo fiet istud, quóniam virum non cognósco? Et respóndens Gábriel Angelus, dixit ei: Spíritus Sanctus supervéniet in te et virtus altíssimi obumbrávit tibi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Then said Mary unto the Angel: How shall this be, seeing I know not a man? * And the Angel Gabriel answered and said unto her: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Joseph. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel Gabriel was sent * to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph; and the virgin's name was Mary. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Hail, Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ne tímeas, María, * invenísti grátiam apud Dóminum: ecce concípies et páries fílium. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord; behold, thou shalt conceive, and bring forth a Son. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Dabit ei Dóminus * sedem David, patris ejus, et regnábit in ætérnum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord shall give unto Him * the throne of His father David, and of His kingdom there shall be no end. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, * be it unto me according to thy word. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Joseph. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Angel Gabriel was sent * to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph; and the virgin's name was Mary. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: Hail, Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Ne tímeas, María, * invenísti grátiam apud Dóminum: ecce concípies et páries fílium. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord; behold, thou shalt conceive, and bring forth a Son. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Dabit ei Dóminus * sedem David, patris ejus, et regnábit in ætérnum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord shall give unto Him * the throne of His father David, and of His kingdom there shall be no end. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, * be it unto me according to thy word. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Dómine, * osténde nobis Patrem, et súfficit nobis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lord, show us the Father, * and it sufficeth us. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Philíppe, * qui videt me, videt et Patrem meum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Philip, * He that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tanto témpore * vobíscum sum, et non cognovístis me? Philíppe, qui videt me, videt et Patrem meum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known Me * Philip, he that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Si cognovissétis me, * et Patrem meum útique cognovissétis, et ámodo cognoscétis eum, et vidístis eum, allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: If ye had known Me ye should have known My Father also, * and from henceforth ye know Him and have seen Him. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Si dilígitis me, * mandáta mea serváte, allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: If ye love Me, * keep My commandments. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Dómine, * osténde nobis Patrem, et súfficit nobis, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Lord, show us the Father, * and it sufficeth us. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: Philip, * He that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known Me * Philip, he that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: If ye had known Me ye should have known My Father also, * and from henceforth ye know Him and have seen Him. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: If ye love Me, * keep My commandments. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Lord, show us the Father, * and it sufficeth us. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.antEng: If ye love Me, * keep My commandments. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Jacob autem * génuit Joseph, virum Maríæ, de qua natus est Jesus, qui vocátur Christus, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And Jacob begat Joseph, * the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, Who is called Christ. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Missus est * Angelus Gabriel a Deo in civitátem Galilææ, cui nomen Nazareth, ad Vírginem desponsatam viro, cui nomen erat Joseph, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel Gabriel * was sent from God, unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, to a Virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ascéndit autem * Joseph a Galilæa de civitáte Nazareth in Judǽam, in civitátem David, quæ vocátur Bethlehem, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And Joseph also went up * from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, unto Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et venérunt festinántes, * et invenérunt Mariam, et Joseph, et Infántem positum in præsepio, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And they came with haste, * and found Mary and Joseph, and the Babe lying in a manger. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et ipse Jesus * erat incípiens quasi annórum trigínta, ut putabátur, fílius Joseph, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And Jesus Himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the Son of Joseph. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Angelus Dómini * appáruit in somnis Joseph, dicens: Surge, et accipe Puerum et Matrem ejus, et fuge in Ægyptum; et esto ibi usque dum dicam tibi, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying Arise, and take the young Child and His Mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word. Alleluia

Ant Matutinum.ant: Angelus Dómini * appáruit in somnis Joseph, dicens: Surge, et accipe Puerum et Matrem ejus, et vade in terram Israël; defuncti sunt enim qui quærébant ánimam Pueri, allelúja.;4
Ant Matutinum.antEng: An Angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph (in Egypt) saying Arise, and take the young Child and His Mother, and go into the land of Israel for they are dead which sought the young Child's life. Alleluia

Ant Matutinum.ant: Consurgens Joseph, * accépit Puerum et Matrem ejus, et venit in terram Israël; et habitávit in civitáte, quæ vocátur Názareth, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joseph arose, and took the young Child And His Mother, and came into the land of Israel, and dwelt in a city called Nazareth. Alleluia

Ant Vespera.ant: Jacob autem * génuit Joseph, virum Maríæ, de qua natus est Jesus, qui vocátur Christus, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: And Jacob begat Joseph, * the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, Who is called Christ. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Missus est * Angelus Gabriel a Deo in civitátem Galilææ, cui nomen Nazareth, ad Vírginem desponsatam viro, cui nomen erat Joseph, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Angel Gabriel * was sent from God, unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, to a Virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ascéndit autem * Joseph a Galilæa de civitáte Nazareth in Judǽam, in civitátem David, quæ vocátur Bethlehem, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: And Joseph also went up * from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, unto Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Et venérunt festinántes, * et invenérunt Mariam, et Joseph, et Infántem positum in præsepio, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: And they came with haste, * and found Mary and Joseph, and the Babe lying in a manger. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Et ipse Jesus * erat incípiens quasi annórum trigínta, ut putabátur, fílius Joseph, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: And Jesus Himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the Son of Joseph. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Deus, mundi ópifex, * pósuit hóminem ut operarétur et custodíret terram, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: God, maker of the world, * has stationed man to dress and keep the earth, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Christus, Dei Fílius, * mánibus suis operári dignátus est, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Christ, the Son of God, * deigned to work with his hands, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Artem fabri * fidéliter exércens sanctus Joseph, labóris mirábile refúlget exémplar, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The craftsman, * holy Joseph, faithfully exercising his trade, shines forth as a marvellous example of work, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Fidélis servus * et prudens, quem constítuit Dóminus super famíliam suam, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Faithful servant, * and prudent, whom the Lord hath appointed over his family, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Joseph, ópifex sancte, * ópera nostra tuére, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O Joseph, holy workman, * defend our work, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exit homo * ad opus suum, et ad labórem suum usque ad vésperum, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Man goes forth * to his work, and to his labor until the evening, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Jesus, * cum esset trigínta annórum, putabátur fílius Joseph, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Jesus, * when he was thirty years old, was reckoned the son of Joseph, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Nonne hic est * fabri fílius? Nonne hic est fílius Joseph? Allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Is not this * the carpenter's son? Is not this the son of Joseph? Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Deus, mundi ópifex, * pósuit hóminem ut operarétur et custodíret terram, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: God, maker of the world, * has stationed man to dress and keep the earth, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Christus, Dei Fílius, * mánibus suis operári dignátus est, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Christ, the Son of God, * deigned to work with his hands, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Artem fabri * fidéliter exércens sanctus Joseph, labóris mirábile refúlget exémplar, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The craftsman, * holy Joseph, faithfully exercising his trade, shines forth as a marvellous example of work, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Fidélis servus * et prudens, quem constítuit Dóminus super famíliam suam, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Faithful servant, * and prudent, whom the Lord hath appointed over his family, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Joseph, ópifex sancte, * ópera nostra tuére, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O Joseph, holy workman, * defend our work, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: O magnum pietátis opus: * mors mórtua tunc est, in ligno quando mórtua Vita fuit.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O what a work of love was that * when Life and death died together upon the Tree. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Salva nos, * Christe Salvátor, per virtútem Crucis: qui salvásti Petrum in mari, miserére nobis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Save us, * O Christ the Saviour, save us through the might of thy Cross Thou Who didst save Peter when he was ready to sink in the sea, have mercy upon us. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce Crucem Dómini, * fúgite, partes advérsæ, vicit leo de tribu Juda, radix David, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold, the Cross of the Lord! * fly, ye ranks of the adversary! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Nos autem gloriári * opórtet in Cruce Dómini nostri Jesu Christi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: But us it behoveth to glory * in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Per signum Crucis * de inimícis nostris líbera nos, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: By thy Cross' holy sign, * Jesus, guard this soul of mine from my ghostly enemy. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invéntæ Crucis festa recólimus, cujus præcónium univérsum per orbem micánti lúmine fulget, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: All the earth this day * is making glad memorial of the finding of the Cross, whose light is streaming over every land and people. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Felix ille triúmphus fit salus ægris, vitæ lignum, mortis remédium, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lo, the Cross's happy triumph, fraught with healing of diseases, Tree whereon the True Life dying trampled down the death of all men. Alleluia

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adorámus te, Christe, et benedícimus tibi, quia per Crucem tuam redemísti mundum, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: We adore thee, O Christ, and we bless thee, because that through thy Cross Thou hast redeemed the world. Alleluia

Ant Vespera.ant: Nos autem gloriári * opórtet in Cruce Dómini nostri Jesu Christi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: But us it behoveth to glory * in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Per signum Crucis * de inimícis nostris líbera nos, Deus noster.
Ant Vespera.antEng: By thy Cross' holy sign, * Jesus, guard this soul of mine from my ghostly enemy. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Helena Constantini mater Jerusalem petiit, alleluja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Helena Constantini mater Jerusalem petiit, alleluja.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tunc praecepit eos omnes igne cremari at illi timentes tradiderunt Judam, alleluja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Tunc praecepit eos omnes igne cremari at illi timentes tradiderunt Judam, alleluja.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mors et vita apposita sunt tibi si non ostendas mihi crucem Christi, alleluja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mors et vita apposita sunt tibi si non ostendas mihi crucem Christi, alleluja.

Ant Laudes.ant: Cumque ascendisset Judas de lacu perrexit ad locum ubi jacebat sancta crux, alleluja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Cumque ascendisset Judas de lacu perrexit ad locum ubi jacebat sancta crux, alleluja.

Ant Laudes.ant: Orabat Judas deus deus meus ostende mihi lignum sanctae crucis, alleluja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Orabat Judas deus deus meus ostende mihi lignum sanctae crucis, alleluja.

Ant Matutinum.antEng: We adore thee, O Christ, and we bless thee, because that through thy Cross Thou hast redeemed the world. Alleluia

Ant Vespera.antEng: Helena Constantini mater Jerusalem petiit, alleluja.

Ant Vespera.ant: Cumque ascendisset Judas de lacu perrexit ad locum ubi jacebat sancta crux, alleluja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Cumque ascendisset Judas de lacu perrexit ad locum ubi jacebat sancta crux, alleluja.

Ant Vespera.ant: Orabat Judas deus deus meus ostende mihi lignum sanctae crucis, alleluja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Orabat Judas deus deus meus ostende mihi lignum sanctae crucis, alleluja.

Ant Laudes.ant: Stetit Angelus * juxta aram templi, habens thuríbulum áureum in manu sua.
Ant Laudes.antEng: An Angel stood at the Altar * of the Temple, having a golden censer in his hand.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dum præliarétur * Míchaël Archángelus cum dracóne, audíta est vox dicéntium: Salus Deo nostro, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: While as the Archangel Michael fought against the dragon, * I heard voices saying: Salvation unto our God. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Archángele Míchaël, * constítui te príncipem super omnes ánimas suscipiéndas.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Michael Mine Archangel, * I have appointed thee for a prince over the ingathering of souls.

Ant Laudes.ant: Angeli Dómini, * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye Angels of the Lord, bless ye the Lord always.

Ant Laudes.ant: Angeli, Archángeli, * Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye Angels and Archangels, * O ye Thrones and Dominions, O ye Principalities and Powers, O ye mighty Ones of heaven, praise ye the Lord from the heavens. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Concússum est mare, * et contrémuit terra, ubi Archángelus Míchaël descendébat de cælo, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The sea was moved and the earth quaked, when the Archangel Michael descended from heaven. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Míchaël Archángele, * veni in adjutórium pópulo Dei, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Archangel Michael, come to help God's people. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Angelus Archángelus Míchaël, * Dei núntius pro animábus justis, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Michael the Archangel, he is the messenger whom God sendeth to all the souls of the righteous. Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Stetit Angelus * juxta aram templi, habens thuríbulum áureum in manu sua.
Ant Vespera.antEng: An Angel stood at the Altar * of the Temple, having a golden censer in his hand.

Ant Vespera.ant: Dum præliarétur * Míchaël Archángelus cum dracóne, audíta est vox dicéntium: Salus Deo nostro, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: While as the Archangel Michael fought against the dragon, * I heard voices saying: Salvation unto our God. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Archángele Míchaël, * constítui te príncipem super omnes ánimas suscipiéndas.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Michael Mine Archangel, * I have appointed thee for a prince over the ingathering of souls.

Ant Vespera.ant: Angeli Dómini, * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O ye Angels of the Lord, bless ye the Lord always.

Ant Vespera.ant: Angeli, Archángeli, * Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O ye Angels and Archangels, * O ye Thrones and Dominions, O ye Principalities and Powers, O ye mighty Ones of heaven, praise ye the Lord from the heavens. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dómine, * osténde nobis Patrem, et súfficit nobis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lord, show us the Father, * and it sufficeth us. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Philíppe, * qui videt me, videt et Patrem meum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Philip, * He that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tanto témpore * vobíscum sum, et non cognovístis me? Philíppe, qui videt me, videt et Patrem meum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known Me * Philip, he that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Si cognovissétis me, * et Patrem meum útique cognovissétis, et ámodo cognoscétis eum, et vidístis eum, allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: If ye had known Me ye should have known My Father also, * and from henceforth ye know Him and have seen Him. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Si dilígitis me, * mandáta mea serváte, allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: If ye love Me, * keep My commandments. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: Lord, show us the Father, * and it sufficeth us. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: Philip, * He that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.antEng: If ye love Me, * keep My commandments. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedicta tu * in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the fruit of thy womb. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut myrrha * electa, odórem dedísti suavitátis, sancta Dei Génetrix. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * thou hast yielded a pleasant odor like the best myrrh. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ante torum * hujus Vírginis frequentáte nobis dúlcia cántica drámatis. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing for us again and again before this maiden's bed * the tender idylls of the play. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Spécie tua * et pulchritúdine tua inténde, próspere procéde, et regna. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In thy comeliness and thy beauty, * go forward, fare prosperously, and reign. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adjuvábit eam * Deus vultu suo: Deus in médio ejus, non commovébitur. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: God shall give her the help of His countenance; * God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut lætántium * ómnium nostrum habitátio est in te, sancta Dei Génetrix. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * all we who dwell in thee are in gladness. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gaude, Maria Virgo: * cunctas hǽreses sola interemísti in univérso mundo. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joy to thee, * O Virgin Mary, thou hast trampled down all the heresies in the whole world. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dignáre me * laudáre te, Virgo sacráta: da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be * give me strength against thine enemies. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Post partum, * Virgo, invioláta permansísti: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis. (Allelúja.)
Ant Matutinum.antEng: After thy delivery thou still remainest a virgin * undefiled Mother of God, pray for us. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Elísabeth Zacharíæ * magnum virum génuit, Joánnem Baptístam, præcursórem Dómini.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Elizabeth, the wife of Zacharias, * was the mother of a mighty man, even of John the Baptist, the Fore-runner of the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Innuébant patri ejus * quem vellet vocári eum: et scripsit dicens: Joánnes est nomen ejus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: They made signs to his father * how he would have him called; and he asked for a writing-table, and wrote, saying: His name is John.

Ant Laudes.ant: Joánnes vocábitur * nomen ejus: et in nativitáte ejus multi gaudébunt.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou shalt call his name John; * and many shall rejoice at his birth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Inter natos mulíerum * non surréxit major Joánne Baptísta.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Among them that are born of women * there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tu, puer, * Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis; præíbis ante Dóminum paráre vias ejus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou, child, shalt be called the Prophet of the Highest; * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord, to prepare His ways.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Priúsquam te formárem * in útero, novi te; et ántequam progrederéris, sanctificávi te.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee, * and before thou camest forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ad ómnia quæ mittam te, * dicit Dóminus, ibis: ne tímeas, et quæ mandávero tibi, loquéris ad eos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord said unto me: Thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee; * fear not; and whatsoever I command thee, thou shalt speak.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ne tímeas * a fácie eórum, quia ego tecum sum, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be not afraid of their faces; * for I am with thee, saith the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Misit Dóminus * manum suam, et tétigit os meum, et prophétam in géntibus dedit me Dóminus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord put forth His hand, and touched my mouth, * and the Lord ordained me a Prophet unto the nations.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce dedi verba mea * in ore tuo: ecce constítui te super gentes et regna.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, I have put My words in thy mouth; * see, I have this day set thee over the nations, and over the kingdoms.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dóminus * ab útero vocávit me, de ventre matris meæ recordátus est nóminis mei.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath called me from the womb; * from the bowels of my mother hath He made mention of my name.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Pósuit os meum * Dóminus quasi gládium acútum: sub umbra manus suæ protéxit me.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath made my mouth * like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand hath He hid me.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Formans me * ex útero servum sibi Dóminus, dicit: Dedi te in lucem géntium, ut sis salus mea usque ad extrémum terræ.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And now, saith the Lord That formed me from the womb * to be His servant: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be My salvation unto the end of the earth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Reges vidébunt, * et consúrgent príncipes et adorábunt Dóminum Deum tuum, qui elégit te.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Kings shall see, and princes shall arise, and worship the Lord thy God, Who hath chosen thee.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ipse præíbit * ante illum in spíritu et virtúte Elíæ paráre Dómino plebem perféctam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: He shall go before Him * in the spirit and power of Elias, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Joánnes * est nomen ejus: vinum et síceram non bibet, et multi in nativitáte ejus gaudébunt.
Ant Vespera.antEng: His name is John. * He shall drink neither wine nor strong drink, and many shall rejoice at his birth.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ex útero senectútis * et stérili Joánnes natus est, præcúrsor Dómini.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Elizabeth was barren and well stricken in years, * but from her womb was born John the Fore-runner of the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Iste puer * magnus coram Dómino: nam et manus ejus cum ipso est.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The child shall be great * in the sight of the Lord, for His hand is with him.

Ant Vespera.ant: Nazarǽus * vocábitur puer iste: vinum et síceram non bibet, et omne immúndum non manducábit ex útero matris suæ.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The child shall be called a Nazarite. * He shall drink neither wine nor strong drink, neither shall he eat any unclean thing, even from his mother's womb.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Elísabeth Zacharíæ * magnum virum génuit, Joánnem Baptístam, præcursórem Dómini.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Elizabeth, the wife of Zacharias, * was the mother of a mighty man, even of John the Baptist, the Fore-runner of the Lord.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Innuébant patri ejus * quem vellet vocári eum: et scripsit dicens: Joánnes est nomen ejus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: They made signs to his father * how he would have him called; and he asked for a writing-table, and wrote, saying: His name is John.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Joánnes vocábitur * nomen ejus: et in nativitáte ejus multi gaudébunt.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Thou shalt call his name John; * and many shall rejoice at his birth.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Inter natos mulíerum * non surréxit major Joánne Baptísta.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Among them that are born of women * there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Tu, puer, * Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis; præíbis ante Dóminum paráre vias ejus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Thou, child, shalt be called the Prophet of the Highest; * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord, to prepare His ways.

Ant Laudes.ant: Paulus et Joánnes * dixérunt Juliáno: Nos unum Deum cólimus, qui fecit cælum et terram.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Paul and John * said unto Julian: We worship One God, Who hath made heaven and earth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Paulus et Joánnes * dixérunt Terentiáno: Si tuus dóminus est Juliánus, habéto pacem cum illo: nobis álius non est, nisi Dóminus Jesus Christus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Paul and John * said unto Terentian: If thy Lord be Julian, keep thou at peace with him, but as for us, we have no other Lord but the Lord Jesus Christ.

Ant Laudes.ant: Joánnes et Paulus, * agnoscéntes tyránnidem Juliáni, facultátes suas paupéribus erogáre cœpérunt.
Ant Laudes.antEng: John and Paul, * when they had heard the tyrannous command of Julian, began to disperse abroad their goods among the poor.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sancti spíritus * et ánimæ justórum, hymnum dícite Deo, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye holy Spirits and Souls of the righteous, bless ye the Lord. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Joánnes et Paulus * dixérunt ad Gallicánum: Fac votum Deo cæli, et eris victor mélius quam fuísti.
Ant Laudes.antEng: John and Paul * said unto Gallican: Make thy vow unto the God of heaven, and thou shalt be yet a greater conqueror than ever thou hast been heretofore.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Paulus et Joánnes * dixérunt Juliáno: Nos unum Deum cólimus, qui fecit cælum et terram.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Paul and John * said unto Julian: We worship One God, Who hath made heaven and earth.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Paulus et Joánnes * dixérunt Terentiáno: Si tuus dóminus est Juliánus, habéto pacem cum illo: nobis álius non est, nisi Dóminus Jesus Christus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Paul and John * said unto Terentian: If thy Lord be Julian, keep thou at peace with him, but as for us, we have no other Lord but the Lord Jesus Christ.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Joánnes et Paulus, * agnoscéntes tyránnidem Juliáni, facultátes suas paupéribus erogáre cœpérunt.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: John and Paul, * when they had heard the tyrannous command of Julian, began to disperse abroad their goods among the poor.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sancti spíritus * et ánimæ justórum, hymnum dícite Deo, allelúja.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O ye holy Spirits and Souls of the righteous, bless ye the Lord. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Joánnes et Paulus * dixérunt ad Gallicánum: Fac votum Deo cæli, et eris victor mélius quam fuísti.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: John and Paul * said unto Gallican: Make thy vow unto the God of heaven, and thou shalt be yet a greater conqueror than ever thou hast been heretofore.

Ant Laudes.ant: Petrus et Joánnes * ascendébant in templum ad horam oratiónis nonam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Peter and John * went up together into the Temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

Ant Laudes.ant: Argéntum et aurum * non est mihi: quod autem hábeo, hoc tibi do.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Silver and gold have I none, * but such as I have, give I thee.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dixit Angelus ad Petrum: * Circúmda tibi vestiméntum tuum, et séquere me.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel said unto Peter: * Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, et liberávit me de manu Heródis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord hath sent * His Angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tu es Petrus, * et super hanc petram ædificábo Ecclésiam meam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou art Peter * and upon this Rock I will build My Church.

Ant Vespera.ant: Petrus et Joánnes * ascendébant in templum ad horam oratiónis nonam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Peter and John * went up together into the Temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

Ant Vespera.ant: Argéntum et aurum * non est mihi: quod autem hábeo, hoc tibi do.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Silver and gold have I none, * but such as I have, give I thee.

Ant Vespera.ant: Dixit Angelus ad Petrum: * Circúmda tibi vestiméntum tuum, et séquere me.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Angel said unto Peter: * Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

Ant Vespera.ant: Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, et liberávit me de manu Heródis, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord hath sent * His Angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Tu es Petrus, * et super hanc petram ædificábo Ecclésiam meam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Thou art Peter * and upon this Rock I will build My Church.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Jurávit Dóminus, * et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Lord hath sworn * and will not repent: thou art a Priest for ever.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Cóllocet eum * Dóminus cum princípibus pópuli sui.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: That the Lord may set him * with the princes of his people.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dirupísti, Dómine, * víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O Lord, thou hast loosed my bonds; * I will offer thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Eúntes ibant * et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: They went forth weeping * sowing their seed.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Confortátus est * principátus eórum, et honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O God, thy friends are honourable; * their power is waxen right strong.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ego plantávi, * Apollo rigávit, Deus autem increméntum dedit, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I have planted, * Apollos watered, but God gave the increase, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Libénter gloriábor * in infirmitátibus meis, ut inhábitet in me virtus Christi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory * in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Grátia Dei * in me vácua non fuit, sed grátia ejus semper in me manet.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The grace of God which was bestowed upon me was not in vain, * but His grace abideth ever in me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Damásci, præpósitus * gentis Arétæ regis vóluit me comprehéndere: a frátribus per murum demíssus sum in sporta, et sic evási manus ejus in nómine Dómini.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In Damascus the governor * under Aretas the king was desirous to apprehend me; by the brethren in a basket was I let down by the wall, and so escaped I his hands, in the name of the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ter virgis cæsus sum, * semel lapidátus sum, ter naufrágium pértuli pro Christi nómine.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thrice was I beaten with rods, * once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, for Christ's name's sake.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Qui operátus est * Petro in apostolátum, operátus est et mihi inter gentes: et cognovérunt grátiam, quæ data est mihi a Christo Dómino.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He That wrought effectually * in Peter to the Apostleship, the Same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles, and they perceived the grace that was given unto me of the Lord Christ.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Scio cui crédidi, * et certus sum quia potens est depósitum meum serváre in illum diem justus judex.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I know Whom I have believed, * and am persuaded that He is able to keep that which I have committed unto Him against that day, as a righteous Judge.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mihi vívere Christus est, * et mori lucrum: gloriári me opórtet in cruce Dómini nostri Jesu Christi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: To me to live is Christ, * and to die is gain: God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es vas electiónis, * sancte Paule Apóstole, prædicátor veritátis in univérso mundo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Apostle Paul, * thou art a chosen vessel unto God, to preach the Gospel throughout the whole world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Magnus sanctus Paulus * vas electiónis, vere digne est glorificándus, qui et méruit thronum duodécimum possidére.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Paul is made one of the chiefest among the Saints, * and a chosen vessel; verily he is worthy to be glorified, for he was made worthy to sit upon one of the twelve thrones.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Bonum certámen * certávi, cursum consummávi, fidem servávi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I have fought a good fight, * I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Saulus, qui et Paulus, * magnus prædicátor, a Deo confortátus convalescébat, et confundébat Judǽos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Saul, who also is called Paul, * was made a great preacher, and, being of God increased the more in strength, he confounded the Jews.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ne magnitúdo * revelatiónum extóllat me, datus est mihi stímulus carnis meæ, ángelus sátanæ, qui me colaphízet: propter quod ter Dóminum rogávi ut auferrétur a me, et dixit mihi Dóminus: Súfficit tibi, Paule, grátia mea.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lest I should be exalted * above measure through the greatness of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me; for this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me and the Lord said unto me: Paul, My grace is sufficient for thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Repósita est mihi * coróna justítiæ, quam reddet mihi Dóminus in illa die justus judex.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: There is laid up for me * a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, shall give me at that day.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ego plantávi, * Apollo rigávit, Deus autem increméntum dedit, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I have planted, * Apollos watered, but God gave the increase, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Libénter gloriábor * in infirmitátibus meis, ut inhábitet in me virtus Christi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory * in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

Ant Vespera.ant: Grátia Dei * in me vácua non fuit, sed grátia ejus semper in me manet.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The grace of God which was bestowed upon me was not in vain, * but His grace abideth ever in me.

Ant Vespera.ant: Damásci, præpósitus * gentis Arétæ regis vóluit me comprehéndere: a frátribus per murum demíssus sum in sporta, et sic evási manus ejus in nómine Dómini.
Ant Vespera.antEng: In Damascus the governor * under Aretas the king was desirous to apprehend me; by the brethren in a basket was I let down by the wall, and so escaped I his hands, in the name of the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ter virgis cæsus sum, * semel lapidátus sum, ter naufrágium pértuli pro Christi nómine.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Thrice was I beaten with rods, * once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, for Christ's name's sake.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hi qui amícti sunt * stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?
Ant Laudes.antEng: What are these * which are arrayed in white robes? And whence came they?

Ant Laudes.ant: Hi sunt * qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
Ant Laudes.antEng: These are they which came out of great tribulation, * and have washed their robes and made them white in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo sunt * ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore are they before the throne of God, * and serve Him day and night.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et ipsi vicérunt * dracónem propter sánguinem Agni et propter testaméntum Verbi sui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And they overcame the dragon * by the Blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony.

Ant Laudes.ant: Beáti * qui lavant stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed are they * that wash their robes in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Postquam consummáti sunt * dies octo, ut circumciderétur Puer, vocátum est nomen ejus Jesus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And when eight days were accomplished * for the circumcising of the child, His Name was called Jesus.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Factus in agonía * prolíxius orábat, et factus est sudor ejus sicut guttæ sánguinis decurréntis in terram.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And being in an agony * He prayed more earnestly, and His Sweat was as it were great drops of Blood falling down to the ground.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Judas, qui eum trádidit, * pœniténtia ductus rétulit trigínta argénteos, dicens: Peccávi tradens sánguinem justum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Judas, which had betrayed Him, * repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver, saying: I have sinned, in that I have betrayed the innocent Blood.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Pilátus, * volens pópulo satisfácere, trádidit illis Jesum flagéllis cæsum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Pilate, * willing to content the people, delivered Jesus, when he had scourged Him, to be crucified.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Videns autem * quia nihil profíceret, accépta aqua, lavit manus coram pópulo dicens: Innocens ego sum a sánguine Justi hujus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Pilate saw * that he could prevail nothing, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying: I am innocent of the Blood of this just Person.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et respóndens * univérsus pópulus dixit: Sanguis ejus super nos et super fílios nostros.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Then answered * all the people and said: His Blood be on us, and on our children.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exívit ergo Jesus * portans corónam spíneam et purpúreum vestiméntum. Et dixit eis: Ecce homo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Then came Jesus forth, * wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them: Behold the Man.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et bájulans sibi crucem, * exívit in eum, qui dícitur Calváriæ, locum, ubi crucifixérunt eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And He, bearing His Cross, * went forth into a place called the place of a Skull, where they crucified Him.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ut vidérunt eum jam mórtuum, * non fregérunt ejus crura, sed unus mílitum láncea latus ejus apéruit, et contínuo exívit sanguis et aqua.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that He was dead already, * they brake not His legs but one of the soldiers with a spear pierced His Side, and forthwith came thereout Blood and Water.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quis est iste * qui venit de Edom tinctis véstibus de Bosra? iste formósus in stola sua.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Who is this that * cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this, that is glorious in His apparel?

Ant Vespera.ant: Ego * qui loquor justítiam et propugnátor sum ad salvándum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I that speak * in righteousness, mighty to save.

Ant Vespera.ant: Vestítus erat * veste aspérsa sánguine, et vocátur nomen ejus Verbum Dei.
Ant Vespera.antEng: He was clothed * with a vesture dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quare ergo * rubrum est induméntum tuum, et vestiménta tua sicut calcántium in torculári?
Ant Vespera.antEng: Wherefore art Thou * red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the wine-vat?

Ant Vespera.ant: Tórcular * calcávi solus, et de géntibus non est vir mecum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I have trodden * the wine-press alone, and of the people there was none with Me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exsúrgens María, * ábiit in montána cum festinatióne in civitátem Juda.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mary arose * and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah.

Ant Laudes.ant: Intrávit María * in domum Zacharíæ, et salutávit Elísabeth.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mary entered * into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elizabeth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ut audívit * salutatiónem Maríæ Elísabeth, exsultávit infans in útero ejus, et repléta est Spíritu Sancto, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When Elizabeth heard * the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb, and she was filled with the Holy Ghost. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícta * tu inter mulíeres, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ex quo facta est * vox salutatiónis tuæ in áuribus meis, exsultávit infans in útero meo, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: As soon as * the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Exsúrgens María, * ábiit in montána cum festinatióne in civitátem Juda.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Mary arose * and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah.

Ant Vespera.ant: Intrávit María * in domum Zacharíæ, et salutávit Elísabeth.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Mary entered * into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elizabeth.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ut audívit * salutatiónem Maríæ Elísabeth, exsultávit infans in útero ejus, et repléta est Spíritu Sancto, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: When Elizabeth heard * the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb, and she was filled with the Holy Ghost. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Benedícta * tu inter mulíeres, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ex quo facta est * vox salutatiónis tuæ in áuribus meis, exsultávit infans in útero meo, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: As soon as * the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Visitatio gloriósæ * Vírginis Maríæ ex sémine Abrahæ, ortæ de tribu Juda, clara ex stirpe David.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This day was visitation the glorious Virgin Mary, * a child of the seed of Abraham, a daughter of the tribe of Judah, a Princess of the lineage of David.

Ant Laudes.ant: Visitatio est hódie * sanctæ Maríæ Vírginis, cujus vita ínclita cunctas illústrat ecclésias.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This day is the Visitation of the holy Virgin Mary, * whose famous life still sheddeth lustre upon all the Churches.

Ant Laudes.ant: Regáli ex progénie * María exórta refúlget; cujus précibus nos adjuvári, mente et spíritu devotíssime póscimus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mary was a maiden of illustrious birth, * the daughter of a Kingly race. We earnestly entreat her to help our minds and souls by her prayers.

Ant Laudes.ant: Corde et ánimo * Christo canámus glóriam in hac sacra solemnitáte præcélsæ Genetrícis Dei Maríæ.
Ant Laudes.antEng: With all our heart and with all our soul let us sing praise to Christ * on this the solemn Feast-day of Mary, the mighty Mother of God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Cum jucunditáte * visitatiónem beátæ Maríæ celebrémus, ut ipsa pro nobis intercédat ad Dóminum Jesum Christum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Let us keep with rejoicing the Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, * that she may pray for us to our Lord Jesus Christ.

Ant Vespera.ant: Visitatio gloriósæ * Vírginis Maríæ ex sémine Abrahæ, ortæ de tribu Juda, clara ex stirpe David.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This day was visitation the glorious Virgin Mary, * a child of the seed of Abraham, a daughter of the tribe of Judah, a Princess of the lineage of David.

Ant Vespera.ant: Visitatio est hódie * sanctæ Maríæ Vírginis, cujus vita ínclita cunctas illústrat ecclésias.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This day is the Visitation of the holy Virgin Mary, * whose famous life still sheddeth lustre upon all the Churches.

Ant Vespera.ant: Regáli ex progénie * María exórta refúlget; cujus précibus nos adjuvári, mente et spíritu devotíssime póscimus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Mary was a maiden of illustrious birth, * the daughter of a Kingly race. We earnestly entreat her to help our minds and souls by her prayers.

Ant Vespera.ant: Corde et ánimo * Christo canámus glóriam in hac sacra solemnitáte præcélsæ Genetrícis Dei Maríæ.
Ant Vespera.antEng: With all our heart and with all our soul let us sing praise to Christ * on this the solemn Feast-day of Mary, the mighty Mother of God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Cum jucunditáte * visitatiónem beátæ Maríæ celebrémus, ut ipsa pro nobis intercédat ad Dóminum Jesum Christum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Let us keep with rejoicing the Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, * that she may pray for us to our Lord Jesus Christ.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof

Ant Laudes.ant: Et concupiscet Rex * decorem tuum, quia ipse est Dominus Deus tuus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The King shall greatly desire thy beauty, * for He is the Lord thy God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Potens in opere * et sermone, lenivit iracundiam Domini, et conciliavit cor patris ad filium.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mighty in work and word, * to pacify the wrath of the Lord, and to turn the heart of the father unto the son.

Ant Laudes.ant: Quasi arcus refulgens * inter nebulas gloriæ, et quasi flos rosarum in diebus vernis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: As the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds, * and as the flower of roses in the spring of the year.

Ant Laudes.ant: Quasi stella matutina * in medio nebulæ, et quasi luna plena in diebus suis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: As the morning star in the midst of a cloud, * and as the moon at the full.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Elevata est * magnificentia Elisabeth super cælos
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou hast set * the glory of Elizabeth above the heavens.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Veni electa mea, * et ponam in te thronum meum, quia concupivit Rex speciem tuam
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Come, O My chosen one, * and I will establish My throne in thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Accepit benedictionem * a Domino, et misericordiam a Deo salutari suo
Ant Matutinum.antEng: She hath received a blessing from the Lord, * and mercy from the God of her salvation.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Propter veritatem, * et mansuetudinem, et justitiam deducet te mirabiliter dextera tua
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Because of truth, and meekness, and righteousness * shall thy right hand lead thee wonderfully.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Arcum conteret * et confringet arma, et scuta comburet igni
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He breaketh the bow, * and cutteth the weapons in sunder, and burneth the shields in the fire.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Justitia * et misericordia plena est dextera tua
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thy right hand * is full of righteousness and mercy.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Confessio, * et pulchritudo in conspectu ejus, sanctitas et magnificentia in sanctificatione ejus
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Praise and beauty are before Him; * holiness and majesty are in His sanctuary.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Annuntiaverunt * cæli justitiam ejus, et viderunt omnes populi gloriam ejus
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The heavens declared His righteousness * and all the people saw His glory.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Judicabit * in justitia, et populos in æquitate
Ant Matutinum.antEng: With righteousness shall He judge * the world, and the people with equity.

Ant Vespera.ant: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof

Ant Vespera.ant: Et concupiscet Rex * decorem tuum, quia ipse est Dominus Deus tuus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The King shall greatly desire thy beauty, * for He is the Lord thy God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Potens in opere * et sermone, lenivit iracundiam Domini, et conciliavit cor patris ad filium.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Mighty in work and word, * to pacify the wrath of the Lord, and to turn the heart of the father unto the son.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quasi arcus refulgens * inter nebulas gloriæ, et quasi flos rosarum in diebus vernis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: As the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds, * and as the flower of roses in the spring of the year.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quasi stella matutina * in medio nebulæ, et quasi luna plena in diebus suis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: As the morning star in the midst of a cloud, * and as the moon at the full.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hi qui amícti sunt * stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?
Ant Laudes.antEng: What are these * which are arrayed in white robes? And whence came they?

Ant Laudes.ant: Hi sunt * qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
Ant Laudes.antEng: These are they which came out of great tribulation, * and have washed their robes and made them white in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo sunt * ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore are they before the throne of God, * and serve Him day and night.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et ipsi vicérunt * dracónem propter sánguinem Agni et propter testaméntum Verbi sui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And they overcame the dragon * by the Blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony.

Ant Laudes.ant: Beáti * qui lavant stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed are they * that wash their robes in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Postquam consummáti sunt * dies octo, ut circumciderétur Puer, vocátum est nomen ejus Jesus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And when eight days were accomplished * for the circumcising of the child, His Name was called Jesus.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Factus in agonía * prolíxius orábat, et factus est sudor ejus sicut guttæ sánguinis decurréntis in terram.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And being in an agony * He prayed more earnestly, and His Sweat was as it were great drops of Blood falling down to the ground.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Judas, qui eum trádidit, * pœniténtia ductus rétulit trigínta argénteos, dicens: Peccávi tradens sánguinem justum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Judas, which had betrayed Him, * repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver, saying: I have sinned, in that I have betrayed the innocent Blood.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Pilátus, * volens pópulo satisfácere, trádidit illis Jesum flagéllis cæsum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Pilate, * willing to content the people, delivered Jesus, when he had scourged Him, to be crucified.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Videns autem * quia nihil profíceret, accépta aqua, lavit manus coram pópulo dicens: Innocens ego sum a sánguine Justi hujus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Pilate saw * that he could prevail nothing, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying: I am innocent of the Blood of this just Person.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et respóndens * univérsus pópulus dixit: Sanguis ejus super nos et super fílios nostros.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Then answered * all the people and said: His Blood be on us, and on our children.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exívit ergo Jesus * portans corónam spíneam et purpúreum vestiméntum. Et dixit eis: Ecce homo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Then came Jesus forth, * wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them: Behold the Man.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et bájulans sibi crucem, * exívit in eum, qui dícitur Calváriæ, locum, ubi crucifixérunt eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And He, bearing His Cross, * went forth into a place called the place of a Skull, where they crucified Him.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ut vidérunt eum jam mórtuum, * non fregérunt ejus crura, sed unus mílitum láncea latus ejus apéruit, et contínuo exívit sanguis et aqua.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that He was dead already, * they brake not His legs but one of the soldiers with a spear pierced His Side, and forthwith came thereout Blood and Water.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quis est iste * qui venit de Edom tinctis véstibus de Bosra? iste formósus in stola sua.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Who is this that * cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this, that is glorious in His apparel?

Ant Vespera.ant: Ego * qui loquor justítiam et propugnátor sum ad salvándum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I that speak * in righteousness, mighty to save.

Ant Vespera.ant: Vestítus erat * veste aspérsa sánguine, et vocátur nomen ejus Verbum Dei.
Ant Vespera.antEng: He was clothed * with a vesture dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quare ergo * rubrum est induméntum tuum, et vestiménta tua sicut calcántium in torculári?
Ant Vespera.antEng: Wherefore art Thou * red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the wine-vat?

Ant Vespera.ant: Tórcular * calcávi solus, et de géntibus non est vir mecum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I have trodden * the wine-press alone, and of the people there was none with Me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Heródes rex * appósuit ut apprehénderet et Petrum; quem, cum apprehendísset, misit in cárcerem, volens post Pascha prodúcere eum pópulo.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Herod the King proceeded farther * to take Peter also, and when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison intending, after the Passover, to bring him forth to the people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Petrus quidem * servabátur in cárcere; orátio autem fiébat sine intermissióne ab Ecclésia ad Deum pro eo.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Peter therefore was kept in prison, * but prayer was made without ceasing of the Church unto God for him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dixit Angelus * ad Petrum: Circúmda tibi vestiméntum tuum, et séquere me.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel said unto Peter: * Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, et liberávit me de manu Heródis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord hath sent * His Angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Tu es Petrus, * et super hanc petram ædificábo Ecclésiam meam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou art Peter * and upon this Rock I will build My Church.

Ant Vespera.ant: Heródes rex * appósuit ut apprehénderet et Petrum; quem, cum apprehendísset, misit in cárcerem, volens post Pascha prodúcere eum pópulo.

Ant Vespera.ant: Tu es Petrus, * et super hanc petram ædificábo Ecclésiam meam.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Thou art Peter * and upon this Rock I will build My Church.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Tu es Petrus, * et super hanc petram ædificábo Ecclésiam meam.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Thou art Peter * and upon this Rock I will build My Church.

Ant Laudes.ant: Lapidavérunt Stéphanum, * et ipse invocábat Dóminum, dicens: Ne státuas illis hoc peccátum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: They stoned Stephen, * calling upon God, and saying: Lay not this sin to their charge.

Ant Laudes.ant: Lápides torréntis * illi dulces fuérunt: ipsum sequúntur omnes ánimæ justæ.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The stones of the brook * were sweet to him; all the souls of the righteous follow him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Adhǽsit ánima mea * post te, quia caro mea lapidáta est pro te, Deus meus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O my God, my soul followeth hard after thee, * for my flesh hath been stoned for thy sake.

Ant Laudes.ant: Stéphanus vidit * cælos apértos, vidit, et introívit: beátus homo, cui cæli patébant.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Stephen saw the heavens opened; * he saw and entered in; blessed is he unto whom the heavens were opened.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce vídeo * cælos apértos, et Jesum stantem a dextris virtútis Dei.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold, I see * the heavens opened, and Jesus standing on the right hand of the power of God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Lapidavérunt Stéphanum, * et ipse invocábat Dóminum, dicens: Ne státuas illis hoc peccátum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: They stoned Stephen, * calling upon God, and saying: Lay not this sin to their charge.

Ant Vespera.antEng: Stephen saw the heavens opened; * he saw and entered in; blessed is he unto whom the heavens were opened.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce vídeo * cælos apértos, et Jesum stantem a dextris virtútis Dei.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold, I see * the heavens opened, and Jesus standing on the right hand of the power of God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Assúmpsit Jesus * Petrum, et Jacóbum, et Joánnem fratrem ejus, et duxit eos in montem excélsum seórsum, et transfigurátus est ante eos.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Jesus took Peter, * and James, and John his brother, and brought them up into an high mountain apart and was transfigured before them.

Ant Laudes.ant: Resplénduit * fácies ejus sicut sol, vestiménta autem ejus facta sunt alba sicut nix, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: His Face did shine as the sun, * and His raiment exceeding white as snow, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et ecce * apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Jesu.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias, * talking with Jesus.

Ant Laudes.ant: Respóndens autem Petrus, * dixit ad Jesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Then answered Peter, * and said unto Jesus: Lord, it is good for us to be here.

Ant Laudes.ant: Adhuc eo loquénte, * ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.
Ant Laudes.antEng: While he yet spake, * behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Paulo minus * ab Angelis minorátus, glória et honóre coronátus est, et constitútus super ópera mánuum Dei.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Even while He was made a little lower than the angels, * He was crowned with glory and honour, and made to have dominion over the works of God's hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Revelávit Dóminus * condénsa, et in templo ejus omnes dicent glóriam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord discovered the thickets, * and in His temple every whit of it uttereth His glory.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Speciósus forma * præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou art fairer than the children of men * grace is poured into thy lips.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Illúminans * tu mirabíliter a móntibus ætérnis: turbáti sunt omnes insipiéntes corde.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Thou didst make thy light to shine forth right wondrously * from the everlasting hills, all they that were foolish of heart were troubled.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mélior est * dies una in átriis tuis, super míllia.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: A day in thy courts * is better than a thousand.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gloriósa * dicta sunt de te, cívitas Dei.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Glorious things are spoken * of thee, O city of God!

Ant Matutinum.ant: Thabor et Hermon * in nómine tuo exsultábunt: tuum brácchium cum poténtia.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy Name. * Thou hast a mighty arm.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lux orta est * justo, et rectis corde lætítia.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Light is sprung up for the righteous, * and gladness for the upright in heart.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Confessiónem * et decórem índuit, amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He was clothed with honour and majesty, * covering Himself with light as with a garment.

Ant Vespera.ant: Assúmpsit Jesus * Petrum, et Jacóbum, et Joánnem fratrem ejus, et duxit eos in montem excélsum seórsum, et transfigurátus est ante eos.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Jesus took Peter, * and James, and John his brother, and brought them up into an high mountain apart and was transfigured before them.

Ant Vespera.ant: Resplénduit * fácies ejus sicut sol, vestiménta autem ejus facta sunt alba sicut nix, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: His Face did shine as the sun, * and His raiment exceeding white as snow, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Et ecce * apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Jesu.
